requiredTestAnchors: does not fall in infinite loop
behavioralChecks: Both secure runtime entry points must return an empty string for explicit zero-size generation.
Fractional-size generation must not cause a later default-size Nano ID to repeat.
Every default Nano ID character must belong to urlAlphabet.
Constructed Chalk instances must honor their configured color level and public typing.
Nested and chained styles must continue to apply and close ANSI sequences correctly.
The visible modifier must emit content only when the active color level enables visibility semantics.
Deeply nested class-value arrays must flatten in order while ignoring empty values.
Objects with truthy push/pop keys must remain object class maps, not be mistaken for arrays.
Recursive arrays accepted by the public type must flatten equivalently at runtime.
The last duplicate assignment must win and all supported line-ending conventions must parse equivalently.
export-prefixed environment declarations must parse as ordinary assignments without retaining the export keyword.
parse must return key/value data compatible with the declared API, and config must expose parsed values/errors through its public result shape.
Hyphen must be escaped using a representation valid in contexts where a simple backslash escape would be unsafe.
Every RegExp syntax character covered by the package contract must be escaped without altering ordinary characters.
The public function must reject non-string input rather than silently coercing it.
Primitive and boxed primitive values must remain distinguishable according to the package runtime predicates.
Runtime predicates must classify values according to the public is API rather than type-only helper definitions.
Type-level predicate narrowing must remain consistent with the corresponding runtime predicates.
Hook execution around retries must preserve ordering and request/response lifecycle guarantees.
Retry eligibility and delay calculation must use the shared status/method/backoff constants deterministically.
Retry attempts must use the shared retry timing policy and stop according to configured limits and response/error conditions.

requiredTestAnchors: map works when detached from the limit
behavioralChecks: Calling a detached map helper must not require a bound receiver.

requiredTestAnchors: map works when detached from the limit
behavioralChecks: Existing detached limit.map behavior and its regression test must already agree.
The limit.map helper must preserve concurrency-limited mapping and its declared public shape.
Multiple pMapSkip results must be omitted while all non-skipped results retain input ordering.

requiredTestAnchors: aggregate errors when stopOnError is false
behavioralChecks: With stopOnError false, mapper failures must be aggregated rather than causing the first error to terminate mapping.
An empty iterable must map to an empty array without invoking the mapper.
Invalid queue configuration must be rejected consistently at the public constructor boundary.
Priority insertion must produce deterministic dequeue ordering and preserve FIFO behavior for equal priority where specified.
A custom queueClass satisfying the queue contract must remain usable through the public PQueue options API.
The default entry point must expose the intended base query-string API without dropping or inventing properties.
Values serialized by supported stringify options must be interpreted consistently by the corresponding parse semantics.
parseUrl and stringifyUrl must preserve their documented query/fragment contract and declared return/input types.
Custom replacements must be applied before separator normalization without leaking forbidden punctuation into the final slug.
All declared slugify options that affect replacements, separators, case, or custom replacement maps must match runtime behavior.
Unicode transliteration and overridable replacements must feed the final slug normalization in deterministic order.
drain must yield queued values in order, then leave the queue empty with size zero.
clear must leave an empty reusable queue with size zero after zero, one, or multiple enqueued values.
Repeated dequeue calls on an empty queue must return undefined and keep size at zero.
Arguments constrained by choices must accept allowed values and reject values outside the configured set.
Configured option conflicts must fail deterministically while implied options are applied only under the documented trigger conditions.
Unknown commands near a registered command name should produce a deterministic similarity suggestion when enabled.
